### CVE-2015-1158
- Assigner: apple | Published: 2015-06-26 | Updated: 2024-08-06 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 41233: CUPS < 2.0.3 - Remote Command Execution (remote/linux, 2017-02-03, verified=0)
- Exploit-DB 37336: CUPS < 2.0.3 - Multiple Vulnerabilities (remote/multiple, 2015-06-22, verified=1)

The add_job function in scheduler/ipp.c in cupsd in CUPS before 2.0.3 performs incorrect free operations for multiple-value job-originating-host-name attributes, which allows remote attackers to trigger data corruption for reference-counted strings via a crafted (1) IPP_CREATE_JOB or (2) IPP_PRINT_JOB request, as demonstrated by replacing the configuration file and consequently executing arbitrary code.

Affected:
- n/a / n/a: affected n/a
